userStories.title: Project Scaffold & TypeScript Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a Next.js 14 App Router project with TypeScript so that I have type safety and modern React patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 initialized with App Router (npx create-next-app@latest)
TypeScript configured with strict mode enabled
Folder structure matches CLAUDE.md specification with src/app/, src/components/, src/lib/, src/hooks/, src/styles/
.gitignore excludes node_modules/, .next/, .env.local

userStories.title: Design System Configuration
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I want Tailwind CSS configured with Bitcoin DeFi design tokens so that all components follow the brand aesthetic consistently
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind CSS 4.1+ installed and configured
tailwind.config.ts extends theme with Bitcoin DeFi colors (background: #030304, surface: #0F1115, primary: #F7931A, secondary: #EA580C, accent: #FFD600)
Custom fontFamily tokens: heading (Space Grotesk), body (Inter), mono (JetBrains Mono)
Custom boxShadow tokens: glow-orange, glow-gold
Google Fonts loaded in app/layout.tsx: Space Grotesk (400,700), Inter (400,500,600), JetBrains Mono (400,500)
src/styles/globals.css includes Tailwind directives, grid pattern background, glass morphism utilities, float animation keyframes

userStories.title: ShadCN UI Integration

src/lib/utils.ts exports cn() function (clsx + tailwind-merge)

userStories.title: Layout & Theme Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a responsive layout component and theme provider so that pages have consistent structure and dark mode enforced
acceptanceCriteria: Layout component at src/components/layout.tsx exports Container (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8)
Exports Section component with py-24
Exports PageLayout wrapper with optional header/footer slots
Theme Provider at src/components/theme-provider.tsx forces dark mode (no toggle)
Sets <html> class to 'dark' on mount
Root Layout at src/app/layout.tsx wraps children in ThemeProvider
Applies font classes and sets metadata (title, description)

userStories.title: API Client with JWT Auto-Refresh
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an Axios client that automatically refreshes expired tokens so that API requests never fail due to auth expiry
acceptanceCriteria: API Client at src/lib/api.ts with Axios instance baseURL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
Request interceptor attaches Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} from auth store
Response interceptor on 401 error attempts token refresh via /api/v1/auth/refresh/
Retries original request with new token on successful refresh
On refresh failure, clears auth state and redirects to /login
Exports api instance and ApiError type
.env.local.example includes NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL

userStories.title: State Management Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Zustand store for auth with localStorage persistence so that users stay logged in across sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Auth Store at src/lib/stores/auth.ts with state: user, accessToken, refreshToken, isAuthenticated
Actions: login(accessToken, refreshToken, user), logout(), setAccessToken(token)
Persisted to localStorage via Zustand persist middleware
Exports useAuthStore hook
React Query Provider at src/lib/providers/query-provider.tsx wraps QueryClientProvider
Default config: queries retry: 1, staleTime: 5 minutes
Imported in app/layout.tsx

userStories.title: Code Quality Tooling
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ESLint and Prettier configured so that code style is consistent across the team
acceptanceCriteria: ESLint .eslintrc.json extends next/core-web-vitals, next/typescript
ESLint rules: @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars: warn, @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: warn, react/no-unescaped-entities: off
Prettier .prettierrc with semi: true, singleQuote: true, tabWidth: 2, trailingComma: es5, printWidth: 100
Package scripts: lint (next lint), format (prettier --write src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}), type-check (tsc --noEmit)
